title: Move the replay audit out of the Amplify deploy
description: The Amplify build runs bd replay (about 4 minutes of re-scoring the committed answers; no model inference) and fails the deploy when any studies/ file differs. Author's direction: CI in Amplify is not for evaluations. Amplify builds only: fast specs, bd report --json from the committed studies/, and the Astro build. The replay audit moves to a GitHub Actions workflow (replay.yml) on push and pull request, on Linux, so reproducibility is still checked and visible without blocking the site.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Log 2026-09-23: filed after the author objected to evaluations in Amplify CI. Plan: SITE_SKIP_REPLAY in amplify.yml, replay step kept in scripts/site-build.sh for local make ci, new .github/workflows/replay.yml.

right_now_summary: The replay audit is moving from Amplify builds to a separate GitHub Actions workflow.
